booking.acceptNote: Message to the passenger (optional): your car, where you'll stop…
booking.acceptRequestDone: Done: it's in your drives, and {name} has been told.
booking.acceptRequestTheirs: You'll drive {name} from {from} to {to}, leaving at {time}. It becomes one of your drives, with {name} booked on it; other passengers can ask to join.
booking.acceptRequestUsual: You'll make your usual drive {from} → {to}, leaving at {time}, and pick {name} up on the way. It becomes one of your drives, with {name} booked on it.
booking.askNote: Message to the driver (optional): where exactly you'll wait, luggage…
booking.askSent: Request sent. The driver's answer will arrive in your inbox.
booking.cancelPassengerConfirm: Cancel {name}'s booking? Their seats become free again.
booking.empty: No bookings yet. Find a ride and ask its driver for a seat.
booking.fullForNow: The drive is full for now.
booking.inboxAccepted: {name} accepted your request for a seat
booking.inboxCancelledByPassenger: {name} cancelled their booking on your drive
booking.inboxDeclined: {name} declined your request for a seat
booking.inboxDriveCancelled: {name} cancelled the drive you had a seat on
booking.inboxDriveCancelledRequested: {name} cancelled the drive you had asked to join
booking.inboxRequested.one: {name} asks for {count} seat on your drive
booking.inboxRequested.other: {name} asks for {count} seats on your drive
booking.inboxWithdrawn: {name} withdrew their request for a seat
booking.mineAccepted: Your seat on this drive is booked.
booking.mineRequested: You asked for a seat. Waiting for the driver's answer.
booking.priceNote: Nothing is paid through the app: you settle with the driver. The price falls if more passengers join.
booking.title: Your bookings
